newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Fiskaragung says first-half net soars.
newsitem.headline: Fiskaragung says first-half net soars.

text.p: Indonesian salt processor PT Fiskaragung Perkasa said on Tuesday it posted a net profit of 61.06 billion rupiah in the first six months of 1997 against 29.52 billion rupiah in the same period of last year.
"The firm posted a net profit of 61.06 billion rupiah in the first half of this year," corporate secretary Tirta Prabowo told Reuters.
Prabowo said Fiskaragung recorded total revenues of 196.97 billion rupiah in the first six months of 1997 against 109.21 billion rupiah in the same period of last year.
He said the firm did not expect the rupiah depreciation against the dollar to have much impact on the earnings this year.
"The firm has short-term bank loans of around $39.5 million, but some $35 million of the loans are still in bank deposits," Prabowo said.
"We still expect to post some 144.6 billion rupiah net profit this year despite the rupiah depreciation," Prabowo said.
Fiskaragung posted a net profit of 80.17 billion rupiah in 1996.
Prabowo did not give further details, but added the firm expected to release details of the first-half results later this month.
